<div class="chatbot-container">

<div class="chat-header">

<div class="chatbot-disclaimer">
<small>ℹ️ This chatbot provides quick answers about Isfar's professional background. For detailed conversations or specific inquiries, please <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/isfarbaset/" target="_blank">connect on LinkedIn</a> or reach out directly.</small>
</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-window">

<div class="message-content">
👋 Hi there! I'm Isfar's advanced AI assistant, powered by sophisticated conversational AI technology. I understand context, remember our conversation, and provide natural, detailed responses about her professional journey and background.

**I excel at discussing:**
• Her inspiring journey from Dhaka, Bangladesh to becoming a data scientist in the US
• Detailed technical expertise in Python, SQL, data visualization, and machine learning
• Educational achievements including her 4.0 GPA Master's from Georgetown University
• Professional experience at Shift Digital working with enterprise clients
• Personal interests, cultural background, and creative pursuits
• Career aspirations and her passion for making data accessible to everyone

I'm designed to have natural, flowing conversations just like ChatGPT or Claude. Feel free to ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, or dive deep into any topic. What aspect of Isfar's story would you like to explore first?
</div>
</div>

<div class="suggestion-chip">What are her hobbies?</div>
</div>

<input type="text" id="chat-input" placeholder="Type your question here..." />
<button id="send-button">

<path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/>
<path d="m22 2-11 10"/>
</svg>
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
// Advanced Conversational AI System for Isfar's Portfolio
class IsfarChatbotAI {
  constructor() {
    this.conversationHistory = [];
    this.context = {};
    this.isProcessing = false;
    this.messageCount = 0;
    
    // Comprehensive knowledge base
    this.knowledgeBase = {
      background: {
        keywords: ['background', 'origin', 'from', 'hometown', 'where', 'born', 'grew', 'dhaka', 'bangladesh', 'heritage', 'culture', 'journey'],
        response: "Isfar's journey is truly inspiring! She's originally from Dhaka, Bangladesh - a vibrant, bustling capital city with over 10 million people. Coming to the US in 2015 to pursue her dreams in technology, she first lived in West Michigan and then moved to Northern Virginia in 2022. She's experienced diverse American communities while maintaining strong ties to her Bengali cultural heritage - it's this multicultural perspective that makes her approach to problem-solving so unique and valuable.",
        followups: [
          "Would you like to know more about her cultural background and how it influences her work?",
          "Are you curious about her experience adapting to life in different parts of America?"
        ]
      },
      
      education: {
        keywords: ['education', 'educational', 'academic', 'study', 'studied', 'degree', 'school', 'university', 'college', 'georgetown', 'grand', 'valley', 'computer', 'science', 'data', 'gpa', 'masters', 'bachelors', 'graduation', 'graduated'],
        response: "Isfar's educational journey is a testament to her dedication and strategic thinking. She earned her Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Grand Valley State University (2015-2020), building a solid foundation in programming and systems thinking. Recognizing the power of data in modern business, she pursued her Master of Science in Data Science & Analytics from Georgetown University, completing it in 2025 with an exceptional 4.0 GPA while working full-time - demonstrating remarkable time management and commitment to excellence.",
        followups: [
          "Would you like to know more about her academic achievements and work-study balance?",
          "Are you curious about how her computer science background enhances her data science work?"
        ]
      },
      
      experience: {
        keywords: ['experience', 'work', 'job', 'career', 'professional', 'shift', 'digital', 'array', 'engineers', 'data', 'analyst', 'enterprise'],
        response: "With 5 years of professional experience in tech, Isfar currently serves as a Data Analyst II at Shift Digital, working in the Data Operations and Analytics team to collaborate with enterprise clients and transform complex raw data into strategic, actionable insights. Her career shows impressive growth - from Computer Engineer at Array of Engineers (2020-2021) in aerospace software verification, to Data Analyst I (Nov 2021-May 2025), and now to her current senior role as Data Analyst II (May 2025-Present) after completing her Master's from Georgetown. What makes her exceptional is her ability to bridge technical complexity with business strategy while continuously advancing in her field.",
        followups: [
          "Would you like to hear about specific projects she's worked on with enterprise clients?",
          "Are you curious about her transition from software engineering to data science?"
        ]
      },
      
      skills: {
        keywords: ['skills', 'technologies', 'programming', 'languages', 'tools', 'python', 'sql', 'r', 'tableau', 'plotly', 'machine', 'learning', 'technical'],
        response: "Isfar's technical arsenal is both broad and deep. She's proficient in Python, SQL, and R for sophisticated data manipulation and statistical analysis. Her expertise extends to visualization tools like Plotly and Tableau, machine learning frameworks, and database architecture. But what truly sets her apart is her ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable business insights - she's essentially a bridge between the technical and business worlds.",
        followups: [
          "Would you like to know how she applies these technical skills to solve real business problems?",
          "Are you curious about her learning journey and staying current with new technologies?"
        ]
      },
      
      hobbies: {
        keywords: ['hobbies', 'interests', 'free', 'time', 'fun', 'enjoy', 'like', 'love', 'outside', 'work', 'cafes', 'food', 'painting', 'reading', 'movies', 'creative'],
        response: "Outside of her professional life, Isfar is a true connoisseur of life's beautiful moments! She has a passion for discovering charming cafes and hidden culinary gems - there's something magical about finding that perfect coffee shop atmosphere or experiencing an authentic dish from a new culture. As an artist at heart, she finds peace and creative expression through painting, which provides wonderful balance to her analytical work. She's also an avid reader and film enthusiast, always seeking new perspectives.",
        followups: [
          "Are you interested in how her creative hobbies influence her analytical thinking?",
          "Would you like to know about her favorite types of cuisine or art styles?"
        ]
      },
      
      goals: {
        keywords: ['goals', 'future', 'aspirations', 'want', 'plan', 'career', 'vision', 'leadership', 'mentoring'],
        response: "Isfar envisions a future where sophisticated data science drives meaningful organizational change. She's passionate about growing as a thought leader while maintaining her commitment to making complex data accessible to everyone. Her goal is to continue building innovative solutions that empower teams to make better decisions. She's particularly interested in mentoring the next generation of data professionals and contributing to industry best practices.",
        followups: [
          "Would you like to know more about her approach to making data science accessible?",
          "Are you curious about her thoughts on the future of data science?"
        ]
      }
    };
    
    this.continuationPhrases = ['yes', 'yeah', 'sure', 'tell me more', 'continue', 'go on', 'what else', 'more', 'elaborate'];
  }
  
  // Check if user wants to continue conversation
  isConversationContinuation(input) {
    const lowerInput = input.toLowerCase().trim();
    return this.continuationPhrases.some(phrase => {
      const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${phrase}\\b`, 'i');
      return regex.test(lowerInput);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle conversation continuation
  handleConversationContinuation() {
    if (this.conversationHistory.length === 0) {
      return "I'd love to continue our conversation! What specific aspect of Isfar's journey would you like to explore? I can tell you about her professional experience, educational background, technical skills, personal interests, or her inspiring story from Bangladesh to becoming a successful data scientist in America.";
    }
    
    const lastEntry = this.conversationHistory[this.conversationHistory.length - 1];
    if (lastEntry && lastEntry.followups && lastEntry.followups.length > 0) {
      const followup = lastEntry.followups[Math.floor(Math.random() * lastEntry.followups.length)];
      return `Absolutely! I'm glad you want to know more. ${followup}`;
    }
    
    return "I'm happy to continue! What other aspects of Isfar's professional journey or personal story would you like to explore?";
  }
  
  // Find best matching response with improved phrase matching
  findBestResponse(userInput) {
    const input = userInput.toLowerCase();
    let bestMatch = null;
    let highestScore = 0;
    let matchedCategory = null;
    
    // Check for conversation continuation first
    if (this.isConversationContinuation(input)) {
      return {
        response: this.handleConversationContinuation(),
        category: 'continuation',
        score: 1.0
      };
    }
    
    // Check for specific quantitative questions (highest priority)
    if ((input.includes('how many years') || input.includes('years of')) && (input.includes('experience') || input.includes('work'))) {
      return {
        response: "Isfar has approximately 5 years of professional experience in the tech industry! Her journey began in 2020 as a Computer Engineer at Array of Engineers, where she worked on aerospace software verification for about a year. Then in November 2021, she transitioned into data science as a Data Analyst I at Shift Digital, and was recently promoted to Data Analyst II in May 2025 after completing her Master's degree from Georgetown University. This progression shows not just years of experience, but continuous growth and advancement in her field.",
        category: 'experience_years',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          "Would you like to know more about her career progression and key achievements?",
          "Are you curious about how she's grown professionally during these 5 years?"
        ]
      };
    }
    
    if ((input.includes('how long') || input.includes('how much experience')) && (input.includes('working') || input.includes('work') || input.includes('experience'))) {
      return {
        response: "Isfar has been working in the technology field for about 5 years now, starting her professional journey in 2020. She's been with Shift Digital for nearly 4 years (since November 2021), progressing from Data Analyst I to her current role as Data Analyst II, which she was promoted to in May 2025 after completing her Master's degree. Her consistent growth and advancement show her dedication to continuous improvement and excellence in data science.",
        category: 'experience_duration',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          "Would you like to hear about her specific achievements during this time?",
          "Are you interested in learning about her career trajectory and growth?"
        ]
      };
    }
    
    // Check for education duration questions
    if ((input.includes('how many years') || input.includes('years of')) && (input.includes('education') || input.includes('study') || input.includes('school'))) {
      return {
        response: "Isfar has dedicated 10 years to her higher education journey! She earned her Bachelor's in Computer Science from Grand Valley State University (2015-2020) - that's 5 years of undergraduate study. Then she pursued her Master's in Data Science & Analytics from Georgetown University (2023-2025) - another 2 years of graduate study, which she completed with an exceptional 4.0 GPA while working full-time. This represents a decade of continuous learning and academic excellence in STEM fields.",
        category: 'education_years',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          "Would you like to know more about her academic achievements and work-study balance?",
          "Are you curious about how she maintained a 4.0 GPA while working full-time?"
        ]
      };
    }
    
    // Check for specific multi-word phrases first (higher priority)
    const multiWordPhrases = {
      'educational background': 'education',
      'education background': 'education',
      'academic background': 'education',
      'school background': 'education',
      'university background': 'education',
      'work experience': 'experience',
      'professional experience': 'experience',
      'job experience': 'experience',
      'career experience': 'experience',
      'technical skills': 'skills',
      'programming skills': 'skills',
      'technology skills': 'skills',
      'cultural background': 'background',
      'personal background': 'background',
      'family background': 'background'
    };
    
    // Check for multi-word phrases first
    for (const [phrase, category] of Object.entries(multiWordPhrases)) {
      if (input.includes(phrase)) {
        return {
          response: this.knowledgeBase[category].response,
          category: category,
          score: 10, // High priority for exact phrase matches
          followups: this.knowledgeBase[category].followups
        };
      }
    }
    
    // Search through knowledge base with improved keyword matching
    Object.entries(this.knowledgeBase).forEach(([category, data]) => {
      let score = 0;
      let keywordMatches = 0;
      
      // Count keyword matches with better scoring
      data.keywords.forEach(keyword => {
        if (input.includes(keyword)) {
          keywordMatches++;
          // Give more weight to longer, more specific keywords
          if (keyword.length > 6) {
            score += 3;
          } else if (keyword.length > 4) {
            score += 2;
          } else {
            score += 1;
          }
        }
      });
      
      // Bonus for multiple keyword matches in same category
      if (keywordMatches > 1) {
        score += keywordMatches;
      }
      
      if (score > highestScore) {
        highestScore = score;
        bestMatch = data;
        matchedCategory = category;
      }
    });
    
    return {
      response: bestMatch ? bestMatch.response : this.getFallbackResponse(),
      category: matchedCategory,
      score: highestScore,
      followups: bestMatch ? bestMatch.followups : []
    };
  }
  
  // Generate fallback responses
  getFallbackResponse() {
    const fallbacks = [
      "That's an interesting question! While I don't have specific information about that, I'd love to tell you about Isfar's inspiring journey in data science. What aspect interests you most?",
      "I don't have details on that particular topic, but there's so much fascinating information about Isfar's career and background. Would you like to explore her professional growth or personal story?",
      "That's outside my current knowledge base, but I have comprehensive insights about Isfar's professional journey. What would you like to discover about her data science career?"
    ];
    
    return fallbacks[Math.floor(Math.random() * fallbacks.length)];
  }
  
  // Check for inappropriate content
  isInappropriateContent(message) {
    const inappropriatePatterns = [
      /\b(phone|number|address|email|contact|personal|private)\b/i,
      /\b(date|dating|relationship|single|married|romantic)\b/i,
      /\b(sexy|hot|beautiful|attractive|looks|appearance)\b/i,
      /\b(help.*with|solve.*problem|homework|assignment)\b/i,
      /\b(money|salary|pay|wage|income)\b/i,
      /(.)\1{4,}/ // Repeated characters
    ];
    
    return inappropriatePatterns.some(pattern => pattern.test(message));
  }
  
  // Get guardrail response
  getGuardrailResponse() {
    const responses = [
      "I'm here to share insights about Isfar's professional journey and achievements. Let's explore her career growth, technical expertise, or educational background. What aspect interests you most?",
      "Let's focus on Isfar's inspiring journey from Bangladesh to becoming a successful data analyst. I can share stories about her career progression, technical skills, or multicultural experiences. What would you like to discover?",
      "This conversation celebrates Isfar's professional achievements and personal interests. I can tell you about her work at Shift Digital, her academic excellence, or her creative hobbies. What sounds most intriguing?"
    ];
    
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }
  
  // Main response generation
  generateResponse(userInput) {
    try {
      this.messageCount++;
      
      // Input validation
      const sanitizedInput = userInput.trim();
      if (!sanitizedInput) {
        return "Please enter a message to continue our conversation!";
      }
      
      // Check for inappropriate content
      if (this.isInappropriateContent(sanitizedInput)) {
        return this.getGuardrailResponse();
      }
      
      // Find best response
      const match = this.findBestResponse(sanitizedInput);
      
      // Add conversation starters for more natural feel
      const starters = [
        "Great question! ",
        "I'd love to share that with you! ",
        "That's something Isfar is passionate about! ",
        "Interesting that you ask! ",
        "Here's what's fascinating about that: "
      ];
      
      const starter = starters[Math.floor(Math.random() * starters.length)];
      const response = starter + match.response;
      
      // Update conversation history
      this.conversationHistory.push({
        user: sanitizedInput,
        bot: response,
        category: match.category,
        followups: match.followups || [],
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
      
      return response;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Chatbot error:', error);
      return "I apologize, but I encountered an issue. Please try asking your question again!";
    }
  }
}

// Initialize the chatbot
const chatbotAI = new IsfarChatbotAI();

// Message handling functions
function addMessage(content, isBot = false, withTyping = false) {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
  messageDiv.className = `message ${isBot ? 'bot-message' : 'user-message'}`;
  
  const messageContent = document.createElement('div');
  messageContent.className = 'message-content';
  
  if (isBot && withTyping) {
    messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
    messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
    
    // Typing animation
    let i = 0;
    const typeWriter = () => {
      if (i < content.length) {
        messageContent.textContent += content.charAt(i);
        i++;
        messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
        setTimeout(typeWriter, 20 + Math.random() * 30);
      }
    };
    
    setTimeout(typeWriter, 300);
  } else {
    messageContent.textContent = content;
    messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
    messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  }
  
  return messageDiv;
}

function addTypingIndicator() {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'message bot-message typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="message-content"><div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>';
  messagesContainer.appendChild(typingDiv);
  messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  return typingDiv;
}

function removeTypingIndicator(typingDiv) {
  if (typingDiv && typingDiv.parentNode) {
    typingDiv.parentNode.removeChild(typingDiv);
  }
}

// Main message handling
function handleUserMessage(message) {
  if (!message.trim()) return;
  
  if (chatbotAI.isProcessing) return;
  
  chatbotAI.isProcessing = true;
  
  // Add user message
  addMessage(message, false);
  
  // Show thinking indicator
  const typingIndicator = addTypingIndicator();
  
  // Calculate realistic thinking time
  const thinkingTime = 800 + (message.length * 30) + (Math.random() * 600);
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      const response = chatbotAI.generateResponse(message);
      addMessage(response, true, true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Response error:', error);
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      addMessage("I apologize, but I encountered an issue. Please try again!", true);
    } finally {
      chatbotAI.isProcessing = false;
    }
  }, thinkingTime);
}

// Event listeners
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const chatInput = document.getElementById('chat-input');
  const sendButton = document.getElementById('send-button');
  const suggestionChips = document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-chip');
  
  function sendMessage() {
    const message = chatInput.value.trim();
    if (message && !chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
      handleUserMessage(message);
      chatInput.value = '';
    }
  }
  
  sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
  
  chatInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage();
    }
  });
  
  chatInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const value = this.value.trim();
    sendButton.disabled = !value || chatbotAI.isProcessing;
  });
  
  suggestionChips.forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const question = this.textContent;
      if (!chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
        chatInput.value = question;
        setTimeout(() => sendMessage(), 100);
      }
    });
  });
  
  console.log('🚀 Advanced Isfar Chatbot initialized successfully!');
});
</script>

<style>

  max-width: 1000px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 3rem 2rem;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #fafafa;
  border-radius: 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  padding: 3rem 2rem 2rem 2rem;

  color: white;
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.25), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);

}

}

  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
}

}

}

.typing-dots span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.typing-dots span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

@keyframes typing {
  0%, 60%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.8); }

}

@keyframes messageSlideIn {

    opacity: 0;

  }

  }

.chat-input-container {

}

  display: flex;

}

.suggestion-chip {
  background: rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.08);
  color: #007AFF;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.12);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

  background: #007AFF;

  transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.25), 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.15);
  border-color: #007AFF;
}

.chat-input-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: center;
}

#chat-input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 24px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
